answer.text: Protect the principal amount with low-risk investments

explanation.text: The Logic: Capital preservation aims to protect the principal by investing in low-risk instruments such as bonds or fixed deposits. It is typically suited to conservative investors or those approaching a financial goal. The Trap: Maximising growth and aggressively beating inflation are growth/return objectives, not preservation. Guaranteed dividends are not assured under any standard preservation strategy. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation grounded in p.126 (capital preservation definition) and pp.22/129 (conservative/near-goal framing).
